tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi lam rim gyi sgo nas bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakra ya/ don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de gsung sdug bsngal zhi byed dam pa'i chos/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub mdzad 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /dbyer med bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal rang bzhin can/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba'i skabs med pa'i/ /'khor ba chu shing snying po med 'dra la/ /zhen log gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor lus 'di nyid/ /thob pa'i dus na phan bde kun grub cing / /myur du 'jig phyir brtson 'grus drag po yis/ /yengs med dam chos sgrub par༞ /sdug bsngal thams cad mi dge'i rgyu las byung / /dge bas 'di phyi'i bde skyid ma lus 'grub/ /'dres ma'i las kyi 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ /sdig spongs dge la brtson par༞ /tshe 'di'i pha mas drin gyis bskyangs pa bzhin/ /'gro drug sems can 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /yin par nges nas drin lan bde ba dang / /bde ba'i rgyu la 'god par༞ /bde bar 'dod cing sdug bsngal rgyu la 'bad/ /snying nas bskul kyang chos la mi 'bad par/ /gzhan la 'khang ba'i ma rnams snying re rje/ /sdug bsngal de yi rgyu dang bral gyur cig /grangs med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams/ /thar med srid pa'i btson ra las bsgral te/ /bla med byang chub gnas su 'god pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /spyi bor he ru ka las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /nye bar babs te lus kyi nang gang bas/ /dam tshig nyams chags dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /myur du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen khri'i steng du/ /pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan dkyil 'khor dbus/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang /

/sna tshogs 'od 'phros bdag la dges bzhin bzhugs/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs 'bul/ /yi ge bzhi las 'od 'phros dbang bzhi bskur/ /sgrib pa bzhi bcom rdo rje bzhi ldan pa'i/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus tha mal mi dmigs 'od gsal dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas lhan cig skyes pa'i sku/ /'khor 'das chos kun de bzhin nyid du thim/ /bskyed rims rtogs pa rab kyi mthar phyin shog /lus kyi byed bcings mi g.yo gsum ldan pas/ /sems kyi bzhag thabs bzhi la mnyam par gzhag /nyin mtshan rnal 'byor gnyis kyi tha mal pa'i/ /yul dang yul can so sor sdud par shog /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lta stangs la gnas nas/ /stong pa'i gzugs brnyan brtan phyir bsam gtan gyi/ /yan lag lnga ldan rtse gcig legs bsgom pas/ /sku yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa rlung lam sbyangs te/ /'jam rtsub rlung gis dbu mar gzhug cing bcings/ /btsan thabs sbyar bas nyi zla'i lam bkag nas/ /dus me'i gnas su rlung sems chud gyur cig /de nyid rim bzhin brtan pas thur sel dang / /srog rlung 'dres pa 'khor lo lnga yi dbus/ /steng 'og 'dren pas thig le mi 'gyur 'dzin/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor༞ /dman pa 'bring dang mchog gi gnas skabs su/ /phyag rgya gsum la kun+da dbab cing gzung / /rang lus 'od 'phros stong gzugs rjes dran pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor༞ /byang sems ma nyams gyen du drang byas nas/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur gtsug tor gyi/ /gnas su 'gyur med bde ba'i ting 'dzin rdzogs/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /yan lag drug po re re'ang sgra don dang / /sgom pa'i dus mtshams sgom tshul legs shes nas/ /rtags tshad mthar phyin dag bya dag byed dang / /'bras bu mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/

/de lta'i lam mchog ston pa'i bla ma rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod bgyid cing / /lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa so sor bshags/ /rnam dkar dge la yi rangs phyogs kun du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing 'gro ba'i don/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' brtan bzhugs nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sems can thams cad la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi kun du gzigs su gsol/ /bdag kyang skye dang skye bar zab mo'i lam/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor 'di dang mi 'bral zhing / /nyams dang rtogs pa brtan phyir spyod pa dang / /nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar sa rnams bgrod par shog /'chi med tshe dang dpal 'byor phun tshogs nas/ /phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab bsgrengs te/ /phan bde kun 'byung rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /myur du bdag gzhan 'gro bas thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi lam la mchog tu dad cing 'dun pa'i blo gros can rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos kha 'don du bgyis pa'i dge bas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la bstod pa thugs rje'i char 'bebs dge/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī wān bhū mi paṇ+ḍū ka saṅgu ru bh+yaḥ satwo traṃ shrar+dhā bhak+ti krī pa wār+ṣo3be sha nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter dang gnyis med grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba mthu stobs mgon po zhes grags snyan pa'i gdugs dkar khor yug ri bo'i rtse mo las/ /ches cher gsal bar 'thon pa gang gi thugs rje rnam par dkar ba'i 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i 'jig rten dbang po kun dga'i mtshan/

/de nyid rigs kyi thig le las 'ongs 'jam pa'i dpal nyid gzhon nu'i tshul bstan bsod nams rtse mo gsang chen mdzod 'dzin grags pa'i rgyal mtshan cher sgreng ba/ /phyi nang shes bya'i rig gnas kun mkhyen chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta dang de sras thu bo chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dri med bslab gsum dur smrig gos kyis mdzes la gzhal bya'i gnas kun ji bzhin rtogs pa'i nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thugs ldan bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sgra tshad rig gnas mdo rgyud kun la mkhyen pa'i spyan bzang rnam par g.yo zhing 'khor lo'i mgon pos rjes bzung kun dga'i mtshan can sa skya lo tsā ba/ /ngag gi dbang pos byin brlabs grub pa'i rigs 'khrungs shes bya kun la ma rmongs rgyal ba'i myu gu grags pa'i zhabs sogs chos gyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i tshogs la rab dad gus pas yid kyis bstod cing phyag 'tshal gnas skabs kun tu phan dang bde ba'i dngos grub rgya chen 'bad med stsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni dgos pa'i don 'ga' zhig gi phyir bskul nas sa skya lo tsā bas bris pa'o/ /e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa bzhugs pa dge/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī wān saṅgu ru rat+na wār+dha s+ya sto traṃ nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dkon mchog 'phel la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos tha mal skur bstan nas/ /rnyigs dus gangs can ljongs 'dir ches dkon pa'i/ /gdams pa mchog rnams 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad pa/ /rje btsun chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun du khyed zhal blta ba dang / /khyed kyi gsung snyan rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dang ma lus dge ba gzhan/ /gcig tu bsdoms nas khyod kyi spyan sngar 'bul/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nyon mongs chu srin gyis/

/yun ring brtse pa'i nyams thag 'gro 'di rnams/ /nam yang thugs rje'i spyan gyis mi 'dor bar/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o/ /na maḥdharmā tu ma hā su kha ya/ dge ba'o/ /e waṃ// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarbā dz+nyā dhar+m+ma swā mi bud+dha rat+na shrī bha tra s+ya sto traṃ na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rjes sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /rin chen byang chub sems ldan 'jig rten mgon/ /kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dpal dbyangs bzang po'i zhabs/ /rnam pa kun du gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /gzhon nu'i nyid nas srid pa'i dpal 'byor la/ /rmi lam bzhin du chags pa mi mnga' yang / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs spangs nas rab tu byung / /bslab gsum khrims kyi mdzes pa de la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan snying rjes 'byongs pa'i thugs ldan zhing / /chos kun spros pa nyer zhi'i ting 'dzin las/ /nam yang g.yo med 'gro la lhag par brtse/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /kun rdzob snang ba lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /don dam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dang / /'khor 'das dbyer med gnas lugs gsal bar gzigs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan de la 'dud/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma gnyis med pas/ /rjes su bzung zhing lhag pa'i lha rnams las/ /lung bstan brnyes pa grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod/ /'bral med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos dang yid las byung ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /kun tu mchod cing sdig pa'i las rnams bshags/ /dge la yi rangs grangs med 'gro ba'i don/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs su gsol/

/bdag kyang skye ba kun du khyed kyi zhabs/ /gus pas bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /rang rgyud smin nas mkha' mnyam skye dgu la/ /rnam grol lam ston rgyal ba nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul yun ring bsten pas dad pa'i dbang po rnam par rgyas pa dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mtsho kha dga' ldan rtse la gus pas sbyar ba'i dge bas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig e waṃ/ /dge ba'o// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ dhar+m+ma swā mi shrī wān saṅgu ru puṇ+ya ni rā bho ga su bhā kā rā dhā dza shrī bha tra s+ya sto tram̐ pad+ma sha be ta mā la nā maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer mi phyed pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /legs gsungs dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas che/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi dpal/ /bzang po'i zhabs pad dri ma med la 'dud/ /so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /byang chub sems gnyis lo 'dab stong gis mdzes/ /gsang chen me tog 'bras bu'i g.yur za ba'i/ /sdom gsum dpag bsam ljon pa de la 'dud/ /mkhyen rab legs bshad 'od kyi sa gsum gsal/ /log smra'i mun pa drung nas 'byin mdzad cing / /zab don chu skyes gzhon nu'i kha 'byed pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma de la 'dud/ /srid gsum bde 'byung ral pa'i gtsug na mdzes/ /lhag bsam cha shas yongs rdzogs thugs rje yi/ /'od dkar phreng bas nyon mongs gdung ba sel/

/'jig rten dbang phyug kun+da'i gnyen der 'dud/ /thub bstan nags kyi sman ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /mthu stobs lus rgyas mang thos ral khur 'dzin/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gad rgyang cher sgrogs pa'i/ /rigs sngags rgyal po smra ba'i seng ger 'dud/ /kun dga'i gsung rab rnam rgyal khang brtsegs dbus/ /man ngag mig stong gis mtshan dpal gyi sku/ /lung rigs rdo rjes nges don yid bzang gnas/ /srung mdzad 'chi med dbang po gnyis par 'dud/ /mkhas grub zhal gyi rin chen them skas las/ /lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i legs bshad rgyun/ /khyod thugs rin chen 'byung gnas legs bltams te/ /phrin las gaṅga'i rgyun ldan de la 'dud/ /mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo rgya mtsho skyes/ /nam mkha'i nor bu ri dwags mtshan ma can/ /seng ge gsum rtsen dbang po mtho ris klung / /de lta'i rje btsun mchog la gsol btab pas/ /srid gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sgo gsum bsags pa'i sdig pa kun byang nas/ /rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo legs thos te/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po nyid gyur cig /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku dang mi gnyis par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /ma lus mi dge'i las rnams so sor bshags/ /'khor 'das dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don du rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge des rje btsun sku'i rgyal mtshan brtan/ /rnam dkar phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /bstod tshig pad dkar phreng mdzes 'di/ /blo gros dngas pa'i pad mtshor 'khrungs/ /sdebs legs tshig gi lo 'dab rgyas/ /snying po'i don gyi ge sar ldan/ /chu skyes gsar pa'i tshogs 'di dag /bsod nams bye ba'i dpal gyis bskrun/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug /blo gsal gzhon nu'i mdun du springs/ /de skad smra de sa skya pa/

/kun dga' bsod nams las grub cing / /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin 'dod pa'i/ /dpal 'byor bzang po ma yin nam/ /e waṃ// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ sar+b+ba dz+nyā sha lu paṇ+ḍi ta dhar+m+ma pā la bha tra s+ya sto traṃ nā maḥ bod skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu'i mkhas pa chos skyong bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs rin chen gzhal med khang / /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi khrir bzhugs nas/ /sa gsum phan bde skyong mdzad lo tsā ba/ /bzang po'i zhabs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dkar thub bstan chu 'dzin gsar pa'i dbus/ /legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga chen sgrogs pa las/ /blo gsal rma bya dga' ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu la/ /zhabs zung 'khor lo'i rtags kyis rnam rol zhing / /legs sbyar gsung gis nges don 'chad mkhas pa/ /lo chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo rgyud rin chen gling las legs 'ongs pa'i/ /snyan brgyud dam chos nor bu'i ded dpon mchog /skal ldan gdul bya skyong mdzad chos kyi rje/ /phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i ngogs gnas shing / /bsam byung rigs pa'i gdengs kas rnam par brjid/ /yang dag bsgom pa'i gtsug gi rin chen las/ /'od zer 'phro mdzad klu yi dbang por 'dud/ /de ltar lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyi nang mchod pa rgya mtshos rab tu mchod/ /las nyon sdig pa bshags shing rnam dkar gyi/ /dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung / /'khrul pa'i dri med zab gsal rdo rje thugs/ /rdo rje bzhi ldan go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal pos bstod pa dge'o/

/maṅga laṃ/ e waṃ// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu lo tsā ba shākya bhik+ṣu mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīr+t+ti dh+wa dza shrī bha tra s+ya sto traṃ nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal sa skya lo tsa ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab mdzes kun dga' bsod nams legs grub sku/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan chos sgra sgrogs pa'i gsung / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun stsol bzang po'i thugs/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dag tshul khrims ngur smrig rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rnam gsal rdo rje'i ting 'dzin lang tsho rgyas/ /rnam mang chos kun gzigs pa'i shes rab can/ /rnam mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sgra tshad rigs gnas lus kyi stobs rgyas shing / /grub pa'i byin rlabs gser gyi ral pa can/ /nges don lta ba'i gdong gis rab tu brjid/ /kun dga'i mtshan can chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgya chen thos pa'i gangs ri las 'ongs shing / /bsam byung rigs pa'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo/ /zab don bsgom pa'i nyams myong chu bo'i rgyun/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gter la rab tu 'dud/ /legs bshad nor bu'i tog gi rnam par spras/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dar gyi lhab lhub can/ /tshogs gnyis dngul dkar yu ba rab brtan zhing / /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de la 'dud/ /rim gnyis lam la goms pa'i mthu grub pas/ /phyi nang shes bya kun la ma rmongs shing / /rmad byung rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las can/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas bzung ste chos skur ma gyur bar/ /bla ma rnams la rtse gcig dad pa'i sems/ /rgyun chad med par spyi bor rtag brten pas/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa yi smras/

/e waṃ// ༈ /shrī sid+dhi rastu/ rnam dkar dge legs kun gyi gzhi/ /nges par grub pa'i sa brnyes kyang / /tha mal tshul ston rdo rje 'chang / /dkon mchog 'phel ba'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byang chub sems kyi lus rgyas shing / /rim gnyis rgyal mtshan cher gzung nas/ /thugs rje'i dpal mnga' 'jig rten mgon/ /sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs la 'dud/ /mkhyen pas shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs/ /grub pa'i byin rlabs chu rgyun gyis/ /'gro ba'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /kun dga' bsod nams zhabs la 'dud/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /dbul zhing sdig pa'i las rnams bshags/ /rnam dkar las la rjes yi rangs/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag bzhugs gsol/ /bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i dge ba gang / /de yis mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /'khor 'das 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa las/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi mar yang / /mgon khyod thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /nye bar 'tsho zhing rnam kun du/ /byams pa'i phyag gis gzung du gsol/ /'di phyi bar ma'i dus dag tu/ /khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis na/ /rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs kyis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di rnam par dwangs pa'i blo gros kyis yang dag pa'i las la yid gnyis med par 'dun pas nges par legs pa'i thugs kyi bag chags sad pa/ nus ldan dbang mo shrī de wis bskul ba'i zhal ngor/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos smras pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༈ /rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen la bstod pa gnyis 'di bzhugs/ sarba bur+dha s+ya ru pa badz+ra dhaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / rat+na bo dhi tsit+ta wāl+lo ka nā thaḥ rin chen byang chub sems ldan 'jig rten mgon/ sar+b+ba dz+nyā mañdzu shrī gho ṣa bha tram̐ ghṛ/ kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dpal dbyangs bzang po'i zhabs/

sar+b+ba ka re bhak+ti nā stot+t+ra ma ka re/ rnam pa kun du gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /ku ma ra twaṃ be lā bha ba shrī bhūm̐ tau/ gzhon nu nyid nas srid pa'i dpal 'byor la/ swasno pa mā sam̐ ra ga bi ga tā pi/ rmi lam bzhin du chags pa mi mnga' yang / sam̐ sā ra sam+patā sṛ dzi pra bra dzi taṃ/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs spangs nas rab tu byung / /tri shik+ṣā shī la s+ya ru tsi ra nā maḥ bslab gsum khrims kyi mdzes pa de la 'dud/ me pa rā sa ma bya ti brti prab+dhaḥ bdag gzhan snying rjes 'byongs pa'i thugs ldan zhing / tsidhi dharmā pra pañtso pa sha ma tā/ chos kun spros pa nyer zhi'i ting 'dzin la/ sa mā dhi ka dā s+ya tsa la dza ga di/ nam yang g.yo med 'gro la lhag par brtse/ a dh+ya nu kam+pa ma ha t+sa twa nā maḥ sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ samabṛt+tā ba bhā sa de ba tsakra s+yo/ kun rdzob snang ba lha yi 'khor lo shar/ da ya pa ra mā r+tha yu ga nār+dha ma/ don la zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dang / hā mu tra nirba ṇā rā bhe da tṛ shaḥ 'khor 'das dbyer med gnas lugs gsal bar shar/ badz+ra dha ra tsu ṭā laṃ ka re nā maḥ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan de la 'dud/ s+d+yā ma ba le shwa ra gu rwa dwa ye na/ mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma gnyis med pas/ a nu gṛ ha ā dhi de wa tā sarbā tra/ rjes su bzung zhing lhag pa'i lha rnams kyis/ bya ka la ṇa prāp+ta sid+dhe shwa ra twaṃ/ lung bstan mnyes pa grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod/ a bi yo ga hṛ da yā pa tsa ya kṛ tra/ 'bral med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ pra t+yak+ṣa ma no bha wa pū dza mo gha/ dngos dang yid las byung ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ sarba trā rga pā pa karma de sha ya/ kun tu mchod cing sdig pa'i las rnams bshags/ shu bhā nu yo rgya ma saṃ khyā pra dzār+tha/ dge la yid rangs grangs med 'gro ba'i don/ dharmā tsakra pra warta dṛdha tiṣ+ṭha/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs su gsol/

ma mā pi bi shwo dzan+ma trāṃ pā de ṣu/ bdag kyang skye ba kun tu khyod kyi zhabs/ bhik+ta se bā kā ra wa tsā mṛ te na/ gus pas brten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi yi/ swa san+tā nā pa ka sa ma khaṃ dza gatra/ rang rgyud smin nas mkha' mnyam skye dgu la/ bi muk+ta mārga de sha dza ya bhon+tu/ rnam grol lam ston rgyal ba nyid gyur cig i t+ya yaṃ bha ṭ+ṭa rā ka tā yi ma hat+na la k+ṣ+mī pha la/ ces pa 'di rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ s+ya shan+si/ shrī gau re rā har+ṣa pu ṇ+ya ya sha dh+wa dza shrī pha le na ku sha la kṛ ti/ /karma bistā ra bha tu/ /e waṃ/ dpal sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dge bas bgyis so/ /phrin las rgyas par gyur cig swasti/ saṃ skṛ tabhāṣa/ bod skad du/ kā la ka ṣa ya dwi sar+b+ba dz+nya ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na dhar+m+ma pā la bha tra pā s+yasto debyot+pa la sī ta bar+ṣo dhe nā maḥ snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa mkhas pa chen po rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i zhal snga nas lha rdzas ut+pal dkar po'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di rtsom pa'i dus lha rdzas kyi me tog dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ngo mtshar ba zhig bla gos kyi steng du bab byung ba nas mtshan yang 'di bzhin no/ bhaṭ+ṭarā ka bā tsa nen+t+ra pra ṇa mā mi/ rje btsun smra ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /baimān rat+na s+ya dza rgyal ba'i ring lugs rin chen gzhasha med khang / ya dza su bī/ lci ba gnyis/ aṣ+ṭayutaṃtūrasahasrar+dhar+m+ma/ brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi khrir bzhugs nas/ /āsānatiṣ+ṭhatribhubahitash+tsa/ sa gsum phan bdes skyong mdzad lo tsā ba/ kapāl+yasaulotsapadabhakah+yayāmi/ bzang po'i zhabs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ sitomunishāsanamār+dhapayo/ rnam dkar thub bstan chu 'dzin gsar pa'i dbus/ dhāronabosabautsabār+ṣadunanu/ legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga chen bsgrags pa las/ bhīraṇ+yadhīkāshamayūrarīta/

blo gsal rma bya dga' ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ nāṭīkabhāṣadwibageshanāmaḥ/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ pradzaḥsadebāmanitsuḍakedwi/ lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu la/ pādas+yabikriḍanatsakratsih+nā/ zhabs zung 'khor lo'i rtags kyi rnam rol zhing / saṃskṝtabādībatsananadak+ṣi/ legs sbyar gsung gi nges don 'chad mkhas pa/ nish+tsār+thadhar+m+momahārādz+nyaban+daṃ/ lo chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ sūtraṃsh+tsaman+t+ras+yasugātirat+na/ mdo rgyud rin chen gling las legs 'ongs pa'i/ dwīsemanādhar+m+mikasar+b+babāha/ snyan rgyud dam chos nor bu'i ded dpon mchog shrotrād+bhāgepālaka laṃgh+rishīk+ṣa/ skal ldan gdul bya skyong mdzad chos kyi rje/ saukarmādharmād+yashironamā mi/ phrin las bzang pa'i zhabs la mgos phyag tshal/ sāmutrabāhushruta.an+titaṣ+tha/ mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i ngogs gnas shing / āshāyabikhikalīlasaṃbhā/ bsam byung rigs pa'i gdengs kas rnam par brjid/bo am̐shukot+pīramahar+hamāri/ yang dag bsgom pa'i gtsug gi rin chen las/ tsākāranāgen+t+rabimuk+tināmaḥ 'od zer 'phro mdzad glu yi dbang por 'dud/ e baṃsharirobatsamānaban+da/ de ltar lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / naṃbāh+yamār+dhamahrasāgaras+ya/ phyi nang mchod pa rgya mtshos rab tu mchod/ pudzaprakar+m+mābar ṇat+popāka las nyon sdig pa bshags shing rnam dkar gyi/ shuklaḥshu bhā+e shayanū mu d+yiṃ/ dge la yid rang chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ tsakraparabar+t+tāyadzagad+bheduraṃ/ 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku/ shrīnāthakāyāyamo ṣabarji/ nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung / /tāpa'abiwāk+nār+yanirodhabadz+ra/ 'khrul pa'i dri med zab gsal rdo rje'i thugs/tsit+tāmalaṃbar+ṣabataṃs+d+yatiṣ+thaṃ/ zhabs pad lo brgyar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /itinamaḥshrībhūmipaṇ+ḍūlo tsā shākya bahi k+ṣa bi rgyaman+t+ra lam ñdzug+doṣānan+dapuṇ+yakīr+t+tidh+wadzashrībhadras+yashrī.ebaṃdharmamānilikhyata/

ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o/ e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dge/ na mo rat+na war+dhā ya/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad shugs rgyang nas 'bod pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog dang po'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /shes rab sgyu ma'i gar mdzad bdag med ma/ /bde stong zung 'jug mngon gyur bir+wa pa/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin nag po pa/ /zab mo'i de nyid legs gzigs ḍā ma ru/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin a wa dhū ti pa/ /'od kyis mkha' spyod gnas gshegs rat+na shrī/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po rje btsun 'brog /nges don gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin kun rig zhabs/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs ldan dgon pa ba/ /mtha' yas thugs rje'i chu gter sa skya pa/ /mkhyen bzang lo 'dab rgyas pa'i bsod nams rtse/ /mthu stobs 'bras bu'i khur ldan grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa gsum nyin mor byed pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /grags pa'i 'od dkar rnam gsal 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /rim gnyis nor bu'i phreng ldan dkon mchog dpal/ /nyams rtogs lang tsho rgyas pa'i brag phug pa/ /sdom brtson dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /de gsum gdams pa rgya mtsho'i dpal ldan pa/ /rtse mo'i yon tan mthar phyin bud+dha shrī/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs/ /byang chub thugs 'byongs dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal/ /nyams rtogs mthar phyin kun dga' dbang phyug zhabs/ /shes bya kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i mtshan/ /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med chos kyi rje/ /grub pa'i byin rlabs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rigs 'khrungs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/

/gsol ba 'debs so sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rnams/ /bla ma rgyang nas 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig g.yel med rtag tu dgongs/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /khyed las skyabs gzhan med do thugs rjes bzung / /kha tsam min par snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /'bral med byams pa'i phyag gis bskyang du gsol/ /bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi lus srog longs spyod dus gsum du/ /nye bar bsags pa'i dge rtsa ci mchis rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji lta bar/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul pas rtag tu mchod/ /thogs med 'khor bar las nyon gyi bsags pa'i/ /mi dge'i las bgyis de la yi rangs dang / /bgyid du bstsal zhing khyad par tshe 'dir yang / /dug gsum dbang gis sdig sgrib ci bsags pa/ /'gyod sems drag pos kun du bshags par bgyi/ /phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las/ /shes bzhin khyad sod ma gus bag med kyis/ /nam yang mi bgyid rnam pa kun tu sdom/ /bdag kyang 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran gyur nas/ /lus srog longs spyod kun gyis mnyes bgyid cing / /rtag tu 'bral med thugs kyis dgongs par shog /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing dam chos spyod pa dang / /log 'tsho spangs te sgrub pa lhur len zhing / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi dad pa'i shugs dang chos kyi dbyings/ /bden pa'am stobs kyis mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /rnam grol rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di ni rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shrī nā lan+d+ra chos kyi khrir sbyar ba'i dge bas bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig

/shu bha mastu sar+b+ba dza ga taṃ/ e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ na maḥshrī ā di bud+dha mañdzu badz+ra ya/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bla ma rnams dang lam gyi rim pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyis ye shes gcig bsdus nas/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed la gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya kun gzigs shing rta'i srol 'byed cing / /rmad byung zab mo'i lam gyis thugs grol nas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pas sa drug brnyes/ /grub chen bir+wa pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /ko mkhan rigs las grub pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /brtson 'grus mchog gis rab dga'i sar bzhugs nas/ /shar phyogs rgyal po bden pa'i lam la bkod/ /ḍoṃ ba'i he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge slong lus la ma he'i zhal ldan pa/ /byin brlabs stobs kyis myos byed 'o mar bsgyur/ /chos dbyings bden pa gzigs pa'i brtul shugs can/ /slob dpon dpal 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon zab mos shes bya'i de nyid mkhyen/ /lhag par gzhan la brtse ba'i thugs rje yis/ /dpag med skyed dgu smin mdzad nus par ldan/ /blo bzang snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang rigs pa'i gnas kun legs sbyangs nas/ /nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor goms pa'i mthus/ /snang grags sgyu mar gzigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dar+paṇa ā tsar+ya ya la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med shes rab spyan gyis chos rnams kun/ /legs par rtogs nas gangs ri'i ljongs dag tu/ /gdams pa rin chen rgyas mdzad lo tsā ba/ /mtshungs med blo ston zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de sras byin rlabs chu bo kun 'dus shing / /phul byung bskyed rdzogs nor bus yongs su gang /

/byang chub sems kyi nyal 'gro'i bsti gnas mchog /'gro mgon 'phags pas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams gzhung gi de nyid legs dgongs nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa rnams/ /mkhyen pa'i tsha zer 'od kyi sel mdzad pa/ /mchog ldan legs pa'i blo la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra tshad rigs pa'i lus kyi stobs rgyas shing / /mang thos ral pa'i khur gyis rnam par brjid/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i nga ro cher sgrogs pa/ /dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dri med dgongs 'grel rnams/ /legs par rtogs nas gzhan la 'chad mkhas pa/ /sa gsum smra ba'i dbang phyug rin chen grub/ /bu ston rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab 'chi med lam gyi nor bu ni/ /nam yang thugs rje'i mkha' la rtag tu 'char/ /phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can gsal mdzad pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /shākya'i gsung rab rin chen khrir 'khod nas/ /nges don rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje yid/ /log rtog lha min phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal ye shes nor bu'i rtog ldan zhing / /bslab gsum ngur smrig gos bzang gis klubs pa'i/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /chos rje shar pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing / /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gling la dbang 'byor ba/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nges 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /byams dang snying rje'i lo 'dab cher rgyas te/ /byang chub sems kyi 'bras bus rnams spud pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad med rin chen rnam bzhi'i ba gam mdzes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rje'i khor yug can/ /bskal bzang gdul bya gser ri'i dbus na brjid/

/bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam mang thos pa'i shar gyi sa 'dzin rtser/ /bsam byung rigs pa'i 'od gzugs dkyil 'khor ni/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i bsil zer dra ba can/ /rat+na war+dha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs rigs kyi thig le las 'ongs shing / /dad pa'i lus bzang tshul khrims gos kyi mdzes/ /rnam dpyod mdangs gsal thos pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /kun dga' bsod nams zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas khang dag pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus/ /rin chen khri steng bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /brgyud pa dang bcas mdun du yi dam lha/ /g.yas su sangs rgyas rgyab tu dam pa'i chos/ /g.yon du dge 'dun mtha' skor chos skyong dang / /nor lha'i tshogs kyi bskor nas mngon sum bzhugs/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i tshogs/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal tshul du legs bkod nas/ /dad pa'i sems kyi dbul lo bzhes du gsol/ /rtse gcig thugs kyis ma g.yel rab dgongs te/ /'bral med rgyud la byin rlabs rab 'jug pas/ /spros med ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems/ /shes rab snyems ma'i sku la bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rab tu phab nas thog med sdig sgrib dang / /las ngan byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rang lus tha mal sbyangs nas ye shes sku/ /dngas gsal rnyog med gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gsal bas/ /bdag dang snang ba zung 'jug byin rlobs shig /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen pad nyi'i gdan/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /pad+ma rā ltar dmar ba gshin rje'i gshed/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs gsal bar bzhugs/ /thun mongs phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra gnyen bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po dang / /rang lus tha mal bdud rtsir bsgyur te 'bul/

/rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos chos srungs tshogs/ /nor sbyin rigs drug gnod byed thams cad kyang / /ma lus dges shing rab tu tshim gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med bla ma yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis/ /byin rlabs zhugs shing sgo gsum bag chags sbyangs/ /sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga ldan nyid gyur cig /gsal stong rig pa ma 'gags rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes skad cig thog mtha' dbus med cing / /srid dang mya ngan 'das bral gnyis su med/ /bde chen spros med ye shes mngon 'gyur shog /rjes thob chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /'gro la snying brtse thabs mkhas spyod pa yis/ /dngos 'dzin zhen med rgya chen bsod nams tshogs/ /rab tu 'bad pas sgrub pa lhur len shog /ma rig rnam rtog 'khor ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /phyi nang rtog pa kun sdom snying gi dkyil/ /'od gyi gong bu skar mda' 'pho ba ltar/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar son lus ni las rlung gis/ /bskul nas bde ba can du rab bson te/ /'khor 'das ma lus mchod cing sems nyid kyang / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar yal nas nam mkha' dang / /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal 'grub par shog /gsang sngags lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma la/ /nyes pa kun sel yon tan bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /legs par rtogs nas rang gi spyi bor bsgom/ /rtse gcig gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas rigs drug sems can rnams/ /pha mar nges nas gnod byed bar ma dang / /tshe 'di'i gnyen sogs mnyam par snying rje'i sems/ /rgyun dang 'thad pa spel mar bsgom par shog /da lta'i sdig sgrib gtam ngan 'di dag kyang / /bdag 'dzin kho nas byas kyis logs shig na/ /rkyen gzhan med pas sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gis bde dges 'gro kun bde thob shog /sngon 'gro stong ras lus kyi skyon bsal nas/

/ha dang hūm̐ gis stod smad rlung ro sbyangs/ /bsrub cing rgya mtsho bskyod pa nor lha gnyis/ /brkyang bskum srog rtsol sbyor ba mthar phyin shog /dag pa'i gzhi mnyam gla rtsis legs sbyangs nas/ /ha ri ta ka la sogs sbyar ba'i sman/ /bdud rtsir byin brlabs rgyun du bsten pa yis/ /brjod bral ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung dang rnal 'byor 'byongs nas brtan pa'i dus/ /steng gi sna rtse rdo rje nor bu'i bar/ /kun+da dbab cing bzung zlog khyab pa yis/ /rang lus thabs ldan dga' bzhi mngon 'gyur shog /bar chad rgyu rkyen 'byung dus sel ba'i rtags/ /log non la sogs mtshan nyid shes byas nas/ /lam du slong zhing sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de lta'i lam mchog brtson pas rab bsgom pas/ /'khrul snang dag nas skyon med ye shes kyis/ /gnas skabs sa lam kun bgrod rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phangs myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal nā len+da'i chos kyi khrir sbyar ba'o/ /e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /sbyor drug bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na maḥshrī ka la tsakra ṇe gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal sha ba ra dbang phyug gi dam pa sangs rgyas la gnang ba'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi man ngag sems kyi gsang ba zab mo'i don rdo rje'i lung blangs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad gus kyis rba rlabs gyen du bskyod pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan srid zhi'i rang bzhin 'od gsal sku/ /kun khyab sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar mdzad pa/ /zag med bde chen gnyis med lhan cig skyes/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/

/thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar spro/ /skye dgu'i mun sel zla ba ye shes kyi/ /snang ba bskyod mdzad snying rje'i cha shas can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ku mud gnyen der 'dud/ /'gyur med snying rje'i nyag phran rab tu rno/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i gnam kun bkang / /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ri dwags rngon mdzad pa/ /ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas dag pa'am rang rigs de bzhin nyid/ /ma rig bag chags 'ching bas rab bcings pa'i/ /sems kyi mdud pa kun nas grol mdzad pa/ /dam pa sangs rgyas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos nags kyi sman ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /rnam dpyod dmar ser ral pa'i khur 'dzin cing / /legs sbyar nga ro sgrog mdzad lo tsā ba/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge legs bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi rkang 'thung dbang po ni/ /rnam grol 'bras bu'i khur ldan gsal bar gzigs/ /grub thob ko brag pa la gsol ba 'debs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas rnam dpyod ge sar can/ /rtag tu 'dzum phreng gsal ba'i thugs rje ni/ /phyogs kyi mu khyud kun nas mdzes byed pa/ /seng ge'i mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs 'ongs pa'i/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog /legs par phye nas de nyid ston mdzad pa/ /dol po ye shes mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rten chos kyi mun pa'i smag rum kun/ /rab tu spangs pa'i thugs rje'i rta ljang can/ /brtson 'grus tsha zer 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpag yas thugs rje lha yi lam yangs par/ /phrin las mkhyen rabs bdud rtsi'i 'od can nya gang bas/ /phrin las bsil zer 'gyed mdzad byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang rig gnas la sbyangs mkhas pa'i gtso/

/tshul khrims rgyan gyi nyer mdzes btsun pa'i phul/ /zab mo'i nges don legs rtogs bzang po'i mchog /yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen shes bya'i ji lta ji snyed kun/ /gsal bar mkhyen pa'i shes rab spyan ldan pa/ /grub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi rje/ /rigs ldan rnams 'phrul zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zag med bde stong mchog gi thugs grol nas/ /bslab gsum rin chen mdzod la mnga' bsgyur zhing / /dri med tshul khrims ngur smrig legs 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhan chen rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam yas rgyal ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho las/ /zab don nor bu'i phreng ba rab blangs te/ /rang gzhan blo gros mgrin pa'i rgyan mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rim gnyis lam la goms pa'i mthu grub pas/ /chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i brag ri phye mar mdzad/ /'khrul zhig gzhon nu 'od la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i chos las 'phags pa'i sa brnyes kyang / /dman pa'i gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /tha mal lta bur ston mdzad rin po che/ /dus kyis 'khor lo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung dam chos rin chen khrir 'khod nas/ /skal bzang skye dgu'i dpal gyur 'jig rten mig /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shrī na len+d+ra'i dgon par bris pa'o/ /bsdus pa cig logs na yod/ e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /shrākya'i bstan la rab zhugs ngur smrig gi/ /cha lugs legs 'chang mang thos rna ba can/ /yid la bsam dang bsgom pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyal mchog zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di yang mdzad/ ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam zab rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs so/

/badz+ra yo gā ya ban+da na ka ro mi/ dpal ldan thugs rje 'o ma'i chu gter las/ /nye bar 'khrungs pa'i 'jig rten dbang po mchog /'khrul pa'i ri dwags mthar mdzad sha ba ri/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dza ga da lar dman pa'i rten bzung nas/ /bod yul nges don gsal byed bi bhū ti/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /dpyal ston a mo gha la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' yas chos kun mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /chos kyi sku mnyes 'od zer mtshan can dang / /dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don brtson pa/ /kun spangs rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa'i sras mchog chos nyid bden pa gzigs/ /kun dga'i mtshan can chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /rlung sems dbang 'byor man ngag zab mo'i mdzod/ /chos dpal bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dag khrims kyi sa gzhir byang chub sems/ /rin chen myu gus brgyan pa'i bsod nams grags/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te/ /dpag yas dngos grub char 'bebs bud+dha shrī/ /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas mchog paṇ+ḍi ta/ /nges don gdams pa'i dpal 'dzin grags pa'i zhabs/ /nam mkha' ltar yang byang chub thugs brtan pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus dang sad pa'i gnas skabs legs sbyangs nas/ /sku yi rdo rje sgrub byed sor sdud dang / /bsam gtan bsnyen pa'i yan lag mthar phyin shog /srog chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /ngag dang rmi lam gnas skabs legs sbyangs nas/ /gsung gi rdo rje sgrub byed srog rtsol dang / /brtan byed 'dzin pa'i yan lag mthar phyin shog

/'dzag med bde chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sems dang ye shes gnyid 'thug bzhi pa yi/ /gnas skabs legs sbyangs thugs dang ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lus mthar phyin shog /khyad par tshe 'di zab mo'i rnal 'byor cig /rtse gcig nyams su len la nyer 'tshe yi/ /gnod pa zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams sogs/ /mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gcig tu gces par 'dzin cing / mtha' yas pa'i shes bya ma lus par gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho bas mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'gro ba ma lus pa'i 'dren pa dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dbal bzang pos mdzad pa'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di nyid/ rtogs ldan zla grags kyis yang dang yang du bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen nye bar sbyar te/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tā ra ṇaḥzhes bya ba sgrol byed ces chu mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul gyi dga' ba dang po'i tshe dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ /e waṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /kṛti ri yaṃ yo gi naḥ ke li ku li sha s+ye ti/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa rol pa'i rdo rje mdzad pa'o/ /de ya dhar+m+mo yaṃ pra wa ra ma hā yā na yā yi naḥ sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'di ni so sor theg par nges pa mchog gi bdag sa ra me pā sa ka sin+dha shrī an+ta ba gho ṣas+ya ya da tra pu ṇ+yaṃḥ/ dpal mtha' yas pa'i dbyangs kyi de nas bsod nams kyi rang bzhin sems pa spyod pa/ tad+bha ba twā tsār+yo pā dh+yā ya mā tā pi tri pur+b+bad+ga maṃ kṛ twā/ pha dang ma sngon du 'gro bar byas rjes su sgrol ba'i ye shes bzang po rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/

/sa ka la sa twā rā she ra nut+ta ra dz+nyā na/ mchog gi mnga' bdag rje btsun po/ pha lā wāp+ta ya i ti/ mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa mchog gi bde bar gshegs pa/ /pa ra me shwa ra pa ra ma bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka pa ra ma so so ga ta ma hā rā dza shrī mān ma da na pā la de ba pra war+t+tā mā na bi dz+ra rā dz+ya/ rgyal po chen po'i chen po dpal ldan sbyin pa skyong ba lhas so sor thams cad du yid la rnam par rgyal ba gsal bas 'das lo/ /samātapaṃkhaṃbha dra di ni gcig su/ bcu dgu song ba'i tshes bzang po la/ 'di brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa rdo rje rin po che gsum gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rgya dpe e waṃ na bzhugs pa'i mjug tu rje lo chen gyi phyag bris mdzad pa'i 'gyur 'di bzhin snang ngo / /sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'di ni rab mchog theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas pa mchog gi dge bsnyen 'tshams sbyor dpal mtha' yas pa'i dbyangs kyis gang gi bsod nams 'di yis slob dpon dang mkhan po dang ma dang / pha sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sems can mtha' dag bla na med pa'i ye shes gyis 'bras bu thob par gyur cig mchog gi dbang phyug rje btsun mchog /mchog tu bde bar bgrod pa'i rgyal po chen po dpal ldan dga' ba skyong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lo da lta zla bcu dgu pa'i bzang po'i nyi ma la bris so/ /'gyur 'di sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// e waṃ// ༄༅/ /kun rig brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// na maḥsar+b+ba bidhe wā ya/ kun rig gi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa sdig sbyongs thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rnam snang dbyer med la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren mchog zhing 'di'i ston pa shākya'i tog /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /shar phyogs za hor rgyal po rab gsal zla/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mgon gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i don gzigs rab 'byor skyangs/

/sgrol mas rjes bzung kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kun mkhyen pa'i shes rab skyangs/ /yo ga'i srol 'byed gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang chen mnga' bdag zhi ba snying po dang / /dpag yas thugs rje'i gter chen dge mtshan bshes/ /tshul khrims nor bu'i gling 'dzin bde ba'i zhabs/ /dge legs 'byung gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig gnas kun gzigs dad byed go cha dpal/ /gangs can dge legs mdzad pa'i rin chen bzang / /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mthu brnyes brag stengs pa/ /bod yul gsal mdzad gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i slob dpon grags/ /snyigs dus skye dgu'i mgon skyabs sa skya pa/ /de gsung gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin gnyag ston zhabs/ /phan bde rgyas mdzad gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung rgyud sde'i don dgongs rje btsun pa/ /shes bya kun mkhyen sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /zag med chos la dbang 'byor 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad dkon mchog dpal/ /nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin brag phug pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan pa/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs/ /bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje'i bdag nyid dkon mchog mtshan/ /dri med ring lugs 'byed mkhas kun mkhyen mtshan/ /byin rlabs kun 'dus sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs/ /grub pa mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab mdzes kun dga'i bsod nams legs grub sku/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan chos sgra sgrog pa'i gsung / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun stsol bzang po'i thugs/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/

/lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge la rjes yi rangs/ /grangs med skye dgu smin grol ma gyur bar/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dmigs yul tshe 'das 'di yis gtso byas pa'i/ /mar gyur 'gro bas dug gsum gyis bslangs te/ /mi dge'i las rnams che chung ci bsags pa/ /bla ma rnam snang chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /mnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyi bshags bgyid na/ /bdag dang srid mtshor 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams/ /las ngan sdig sgrib sbyangs shing lam bstan nas/ /bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge rtsa 'dis mtshon nas/ /dus gsum rnam dkar dge ba ci bsags mthus/ /tshe 'das ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal las grol te/ /khyab bdag chos dbyings rgyal po nyid gyur cig /ces khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa tshe 'das kyi sdig pa sbyong shing mkha' spyod lam ston zhes ba 'di dpal sa skya lo tsā bas lo dgon par sbyar ba'o/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na ma dza shākya sidhā ya/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ngan song sbyong ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mjed zhing gi ston pa thub dbang gtso/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dpal/ /chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes snying / /tshogs gnyis lhun grub ye shes bzhi ba'i zhabs/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad sangs rgyas zhi ba'i dpal/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i gsal byed sangs rgyas gsang / /nam yang dge ba'i rang bzhin ku sa la/ /bsgrub la brtson mdzad ku sa la gnyis pa/ /chos kyi grags pa'i mtshan can gser gling pa/ /byang chub thugs 'byongs dpal ldan a ti sha /bden gnyis don bsgom go mi sgom chen pa/

/gnyis med ye shes rab brnyes dz+nyā na shrī/ /ldom bu'i zas kyi 'tsho ba'i gnyag ston zhabs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston grags pa'i mtshan/ /rmad byung dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan can/ /rin chen 'od zer 'phro ba'i bya ston pa/ /bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i glo chen zhabs/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bla ma'i mos gus gtsor mdzad shes rdor ba/ /skad gnyis smra ba ma ṇi ka shrī'i zhabs/ /'chi med rig 'dzin sa bzang 'phags pa dang / /rmad byung bshad bsgrub rgyas mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /rim gnyis rtogs pa mthar phyin dkon mchog mtshan/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin kun dbang zhabs/ /nges don gnas lugs gzigs pa'i dkon mchog 'phel/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i 'jam dbyangs ā nan+ta/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das/ /mi 'khrugs mgon po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'das gtso byas rigs drug sems can rnams/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal rab spangs te/ /mtho ris skye rga na 'chi'i 'jigs bral nas/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye bar shog /zhing der mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhal mthong nas/ /theg mchog chos kyis gsung dbyangs legs thos te/ /gnyis med 'od gsal thugs kyis rab bzung nas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa thob shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun du yang / /dal 'byor lus thob nam 'chi nges med dran/ /rnam dag rab byung khrims la legs zhugs te/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bsgom shog /khyad par gsang chen zab mo'i dbang mnos te/ /skyon med lam la yid ches rab bsgom nas/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen kun tshangs 'gal rkyen zhi/ /mthar thug rnam grol go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'dir ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sgo rum gzim spyil dkar por bris pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/

/rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na maḥshrī dhar+m+ma dha tu ma hā su kha ye/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang dang lam gyi rim pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i shrī he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan brtan g.yo kun khyab srid zhi'i bdag /rang bzhin brjod pa'i mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur med 'od gsal rang rig bde ba che/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dag de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /dag pa'i 'khor gyi snang ngor kha sbyor sku/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar longs spyod rdzogs/ /zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /o ḍi yā nar rgyal po'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma rungs kun btul nas/ /dpag yas byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags yul rigs gnas rgya mtsho'i grur zhugs te/ /dam chos nor bu'i ded dpon klu'i dbang po/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin gang / /rdo rje rin chen rnam gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das sgyu mar rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / /dmigs med thugs rje'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ /dam pa'i tshul bzhin bslab gsum khrims kyis mdzes/ /bla ma rgyal po'i mtha' can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal rdo rje'i sku nyid mngon gyur kyang / /tha mal tshul ston gtsug tor shes rab mtshan/ /dge legs gzhir gyur byang chub thugs mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /gcig tu dge ba'i chos la thugs gzhol zhing / /yang dag nges pa'i don mthong rig sngags 'chang / /glang gis brag la rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal/ /legs gzigs 'khon ston bal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /snga 'gyur shākya'i rings lugs rnams kyi mchog

/sgrub la brtson mdzad grub pa'i blo gros can/ /gsang sngags mthu yis dam can bran du 'khol/ /'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med dkon mchog gdung 'dzin chos kyi khrir/ /theg mchog 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gang / /snyigs dus gang can dpal gyur sprul pa'i sku/ /bla chen kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /de sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin rlabs pa/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab mo'i lam gyis rang gi rgyud smin nas/ /gzhan la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' dpal chen 'od/ /mkhyen rab thogs med 'jig rten kun gyi mig /sgra bsgyur kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon bsags bsod nams tshogs las bskrun pa'i sku/ /snyan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgreng mkhas pa/ /zab rgyas chos dang srid pa'i dpal yon can/ /'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun mchog las 'khrul med gdams pa rnams/ /legs nos gzhan la 'chad mkhas 'od ldan dpal/ /chos kun dga' bzhi'i ngo bor ro gcig rtogs/ /rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'i thugs ldan zhing / /skad gnyis smra ba legs pa'i blo gros can/ /gzhung lugs man ngag kun 'dus dga' ba'i tshal/ /bsod nams ye shes mthar phyin la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam mang gsung rab mtha' dag legs sbyangs nas/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /bslab gsum ngur smrig gos kyi mdzes pa'i sku/ /chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub pa'i rigs 'khrungs shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /'gro kun dga' bar byed pa'i rgyal mtshan can/ /sa skyong gtsug gi nor bu'i khrir bzhugs pa/ /theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/

/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung nus mthur ldan/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan mthu stobs mgon pos byin brlabs shing / /rim gnyis mthar phyin nam mkha'i mtshan can dang / /mang thos blo gsal rnams dag khrims kyis mdzes/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'am/ yang na chos rje bla ma'i rjes su/ mtha' yas byang chub thugs kyi dpal ldan zhing / /nam yang nyes pas ma gos tshul khrims can/ /skye dgu kun la dga' bzhi'i lam bzang po/ /ston mdzad rgyal bas lung bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig gnas kun la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing / /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs brgyar g.yo ba can/ /gang blo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes nyer bzung ba/ /rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu sngar gyi sh+lau ka phyi ma de bsnan kyang rung ba nyid do/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams/ /ye nas lhun grub chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /sna tshogs gzugs sku sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyi/ /phrin las rgyun mi 'chad la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus dang longs spyod dngos 'byor yid sprul ba'i/ /mchod sprin kyis mchod mi dge'i las rnams bshags/ /rnam dkar dge la yi rangs 'gro ba'i don/ /'khor lo bskor zhing rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dge ba 'di dang ma lus dge ba'i mthus/ /ma rig mun par 'khyams pa'i 'gro 'di rnams/ /brgyud pa gsum ldan bla mas rjes bzung ste/ /byang chub sgrub byed dbang bzhis smin par shog /ma bcos stong nyid spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /dmigs med snying rje bsgoms pa kun du snang / /zung 'jug 'gag med 'khor 'das kun gyis rgyu/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyis nyams len mthar phyin shog /chos sku lam byed bdag nyid rtsa ba dang /

/longs spyod rdzogs sku lam byed khro bo'i tshogs/ /sprul sku lam byed rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /rgyu 'bras dbyer med lam mchog bsgom par shog /zhe sdang rtsad gcod phyi nang gsang ba'i sman/ /gti mug gnas su dag pa'i ba ling+ta/ /'dod chags bsgral ba rak+ta'i rgya mtsho ste/ /mchod pa gsum gyis rgyal ba mnyes byed shog /ma dag bden 'dzin 'khrul snang 'thug po 'di/ /bskyed rim bzlas par bcas pas legs sbyangs te/ /dag pa'i ye shes rang gzhan ngo bos stong / /blo 'das zung 'jug mngon du 'gyur bar shog /mngon spyod las kyi zhing bcu bsgrol ba'i tshe/ /tha mal snying nad dwangs ma lnga yi dbus/ /rnam shes dang po'i dbyangs yig dkar la 'tsher/ /kun gzhi'i gnas tshul ji bzhin shes par shog /las nyon dri ma sbyong byed khrus lung dang / /'chi med chos skur sgyur ba tshe yi lung / /bcu gnyis gnad ldan dgongs pa rnam gsum gyis/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol bar shog /chu bo bzhi 'dus gdams pa nyams len zhing / /ye shes byang chub sems sogs phur bu bzhi/ /nam mkha' tsan dan lta bu'i gang zag bzhi/ /kun bzang rigs bzhi'i sa la 'god par shog /skye ba kun du lam mchog 'di nyid la/ /the tshom med par gus pas bsgrub byed cing / /bar chad bgegs kyi gnod pa mi 'byung bar/ /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med 'grub par shog /tshe 'dir 'chi med dpal dang tshul khrims ldan/ /byang chub sems gnyis zung 'jug thos pa'i don/ /yang dag sems shing sgrub la brtson byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha yis rjes su 'dzin par shog /phyogs ris mu mtha' bral ba'i sems can rnams/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyang pa'i mar shes nas/ /tshad med snying nas brtse ba'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi don la brtson par shog /shākya seng ge'i ring lugs mtha' dag dang / /rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mchog /khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung rnams/

/bshad nyan bsgrub pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings kyi bden pa dang / /rig 'dzin yi dam lha yi byin rlabs dang / /chos srungs dam can rgya mtsho'i nus mthu yi/ /ji ltar smon pa'i gnas rnams 'grub par shog /yang drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bla ma'i rjes su 'di ltar bya ste/ snyan brgyud lung dang rigs pa'i gter mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab rdo rje dang / /dpag yas 'gro la byams dang snying rje can/ /mkhan po thugs rje shes rab la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam gyi rgyud grol nas/ /grub pa'i sngags 'chang dharmā kīrti mtshan/ /rab dga'i spyod pas gzhan don la dges pa/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni chos dang brgyud pa'i tshul lugs 'di la rtse gcig pa'i 'dun pa can/ sngon gyi bla ma skyo ston dri med kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa/ bla ma mgon po rgyal mtshan gyi nye bar bskul zhing / mi nyag gis ston pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas pa la brten nas/ /dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dngos po'i lo rgyal gyis nya ba'i yar tshes zla ba dang / gro bzhin gyi 'grub sbyor la shrī byas 'gyur rdo rje'i ri khrod du myur bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i btsun pa rat+na sā ga ras bgyis pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/ /na maḥshrī sa man+ta bha trā ya/ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas klu yi dbang po dang / /rdo rje rin chen shes rab yon tan mtshan/ /tshul khrims rgyal po rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje gtsug tor dge skyabs dge mthong dang / /'khon ston bal po shākya blo gros dang / /shes rab tshul khrims dkon mchog rgyal po'i zhabs/

/kun dga' snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che/ /'od ldan dpal dang kun dga' rdo rje dang / /legs pa'i blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun dga' bsod nams rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /bla ma dam pa bla chen kun dga' rgyal/ /theg chen chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam gsum ting nge 'dzin la legs gnas nas/ /dam chos gsum bsgom mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ /dri ma gsum sbyangs sku gsum mngon gyur ste/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi kha ton du myur bar bsam gtan phug tu bris pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༈ /na maḥ shrī tsakre ṇa gu ru bh+yaḥ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gi/ /chos gos 'dzin par legs sprul pa'i/ /sa skya paṇa chen zhabs pad la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i dpal 'byor dang / /mkhas shing grub pa'i blo gros can/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa la/ /rtag༞ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur mdzad de/ /rim pa gnyis la thugs brtan pa/ /zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la/ /rtag tu༞ /bla ma'i zhabs tog dka' ba spyad/ /rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /grub chen bsod nams dpal ba la/ /rtag༞ /'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste/ /'chad rtsod brtsom pa'i khrir 'khod pa/ /'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag༞ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dpal ldan zhing / /rnam dag tshul khrims gos bzang can/ /rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /rtag༞ /gnyis med ye shes legs gzigs shing / /gzhan phan lhag bsam cher bskyed pa'i/ /chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag༞

/e waṃ rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu/ /zung 'jug chos kyi sku brnyes pa/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen la/ rtag༞ gcig tu 'asgrub la brtson mdzad cing / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa/ /mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa la/ /rtag༞ rig pa'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te/ /grub pa'i sa brnyes chos kyi rje/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ /rtag༞ dkon mchog dges pa'i thugs ldan zhing / /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros can/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la/ /rtag༞ /dkon mchog gsums dang dbyer med cing / /lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /nges don gdams pa 'phel mdzad la/ /rtag༞ /mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /brtse dang nub pa rmad byung ba/ /rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ /rtag༞ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ dam chos rin chen kun gyi gter/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan la/ /rtag༞ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbangs shing / /grub pa'i byin brlabs bka' bab pa/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la/ /rtag༞ /dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i he ru ka /shes rab sgyu ma'i btsun mo dang / /rol mdzad bde ba chen por mdud/ /zung 'jug de nyid ma thob bar/ /rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /mngal sgong rdzus skyes dkyil 'khor du/ /sbyin bya dbang bzhis smin par shog /zab mo'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'khor lo bde mchog dam tshig rnams/ /ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /ma dag skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i/ /gsal dag bskyed rim legs goms te/ /snang ba lha ru 'char ba dang / /zhi sogs phrin las dbang gyur shog /rgyud rim gnas lugs shes byas te/ /sngags rim gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /ye shes dga' bzha'i rim pa skye/ /gsang ba'i rim pa 'grub par shog /de lta'i rim gnyis la brtson pas/ /drod thob spyod pas mtshams sbyar te/ /rab dga' la sogs sa bgrod nas/

/tshe gcig phyag chen 'grub par shog /khyad par skye ba 'di nyid la/ /mtshan 'dzin kun rtogs rab spangs te/ /ṭeṃ ki dā ri ka pa bzhin/ /gsang chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /nam yang mi 'bral gnas gsum gyi/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig gnas/ rigs 'dzin dbang po nyid gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin brlabs dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu yis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di ni bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i dbe mchog bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas par bshad pa'i tshe sbyar ba'o// //swa sti/ pad+ma 'byung gnas mchims ston yab sras kyi/ /bka' bsrung mthu rtsal stobs ldan pe ha ra/ /mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /pha rol dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa 'di snar thang dpe khang gi srung ma pe ha ra la phrin las su bcol ba dpal sa skya lo tsā bas bris pa dge/ //e wam̐// gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /rig pa'i gnas kun legs sbyangs nas/ /grub pa'i tha mnyes chos kyi rje/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /brtse dang nus pa rmad byung ba/ /rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog dgyes pa'i thugs ldan zhing / /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros can/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la/

/rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa 'di bde mchog bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha bskongs su dpal sa skya lo tsā bas bris so/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/ /swasti/ pad+ma 'byung gnas mchims ston yab sras kyi/ /bka' srungs mthu rtsal stobs ldan pe ha ra/ /mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /pha rol dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa 'di snar thang dpe khang gi srung ma pe har la phrin las su bcol ba dpal sa skya lo tsā bas bris pa dge'o/ /e waṃ// ༄༅/ /rta mgrin yang gsang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ na mo ma hā kro dhā pad+mā na ta krid sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal ba/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dang / /pad+ma rā ga'i dpal 'phrog pa/ /pad+ma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal/ /'phur 'gro rdo rje'i gzhal yas su/ /mtsho skyes las 'khrungs rdo rje'i sku/ /grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i mchog /rin chen bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad du byung ba'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /rdo rje'i thugs ldan rin po che/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /bsod nams brtan pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis chos kun gzigs/ /chos rgyal dpal 'byor bzang po can/ /rta mchog sngags kyi mthu grub pa/ /dpal ldan seng ge la gsol ba 'debs/ /rim gnyis nor bu'i gling mchog la/ /dbang 'byor rin chen bkra shis mtshan/ /spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yon tan mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin pas/ /nus ldan chos dpal bzang po'i zhabs/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam par grol ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/

/spyod pas don mdzad blo gros bzang / /nyon mongs g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /phrin las bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /des gsung lung dang rtogs pa'i chos/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la/ /snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /rus sbal gnya' shing dpe lta bur/ /dal dang 'byor pa'i chos tshang ba'i/ /mi lus shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /yid la nges par byin gyis rlobs/ /glo bur tshe 'di mar me yang / /'chi bdag rlung gis myur bcom nas/ /'jigs rung mun par 'khrid byed pas/ /long med skye bar༞ /ngan song sdug bsngal mi zad myong / /mtho ris bde bar snang ba yang / /sdig sdug skyed pas 'khor ba la/ /nges 'byung skye bar༞ /dkar po'i las kyi bde ba bsgrub/ /gcig tu gnag pas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /'dren mas 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ /blang dor shes par༞ /thogs med 'khor bar las bsags kyang / /don can cung zad mi 'dug pas/ /phyin chad mi dge'i las spong zhing / /dge ba spyod par༞ /tshe 'dir drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma/ /sdug bsngal bral 'dod blo skye bzhin/ /mtha' yas sems can thams cad la'ang / /snying rje skye bar༞ /bdag dang phung pos rnam dben zhing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos kyi stong / /brjod bral don dam byang chub sems/ /gnas lugs rtogs par༞ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin sku/ /nam bza' dkar mos legs 'khyud pa/ /gtsug gi nor bur rtag bzhugs la/ /las ngan sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gling bzhi dang / /ri rab khor yug nyi zlar bcas/ /rje btsun mchog la dbul bar bgyi /thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /kun gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i klong / /chos nyid bde chen ma 'gags pa/ /'od gsal 'gyur med lhun gyis grub/ /lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi ngang las dbang chen sku/ /me dpung ltar gsal zhal phyag rdzogs/

/phra rags spro bsdu'i sems bzung nas/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rtogs par shog /zhi drag blang la legs sbyangs nas/ /byin rlabs 'byung ba 'bar ba'i me/ /srog shing bsre ba 'khor lo gnyis/ /bzhi pa'i mi dmigs mthar phyin shog /dbang chen yab yum nga rgyal gyis/ /'du shes gsum ldan dbab pa dang / /bzung dang dgra la mkhas pa yis/ /gsum pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog /nyams myong bde ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /chos kun dbyings rig dbyer med pa/ /bde chen bzhi pa'i don rtogs shog /gnas skabs kun du sdig pa'i las/ /so sor bshags shing mi bgyid do/ /dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskul/ /'gro ba'i don phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can thams cad kyang / /dri ma lnga dag ye shes lnga/ /mngon gyur dbang chen sku thob shog /skye dang skye bar lam zab mo/ /theg pa'i yang rtse 'di nyid la/ /dad pas bsgrub cing 'gal rkyen zhi/ /mthun rkyen dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /tshe 'dir rnam dag khrims kyi 'tsho/ /mang du thos shing bsgrub la brtson/ /tshe ring 'byor pa'i dpal gyis phyug /rda skad dgongs pa mthar phyin shog /de bzhin nyid dang rigs 'dzin tshogs/ /yi dam lha dang srung ma'i mthus/ /'phral dang yun du dge legs kyis/ /bkra shis phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /ces 'di chos dang brgyud pa la/ /lhag par mos pa'i rnam dpyod can/ /tsan+d+ra kīr+t+tis bskul ba'i ngor/ /sa skyar gnas pa a nan+tas/ /byas 'gyur rdo rje'i ri khrod du/ /rgyal ba'i tshes la bris pa dge/ /e waṃ/ /maṅga laṃ kurban+tu// ༄༅/ /gu ru drag dmar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// shrī swasti/ bde chen 'od gsal zung 'jug gzhal yas su/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/

/dag snang 'gag med lhun grub gnas mchog tu/ /longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma chags pad+ma rgyas pa'i khri stengs su/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang shar 'chi med rol pa'i zhing khams su/ /mnga' bdag nyang ral chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul pa'i dri med bde chen gzhal yas su/ /mnga' bdag sras chung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /spros bral chos dbyings rtog pa'i gnas gcig tu/ /gu ru dharma rat+na la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun khyab phyag rgya chen po'i khri stengs su/ /rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i 'od gsal mkha' klong su/ /drin can sangs rgyas lhun dbang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med zhing khams su/ /sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i rin chen khri stengs su/ /mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/

/kun bzang rdzogs chen khyab brdal ro gcig dang / /chos rje legs pa dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zung 'jug thabs shes gnyis med gzhal yas su/ /rgya gar shes rab rgyal tshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang stong 'khor 'das dbyer med zhing khams su/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / /rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus la sku yi byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /ma dag 'khrul snang zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag la gsung gi byin rlabs༞ ma dag smra brjod bral bar༞ ngag gi bar chad༞ longs sku༞ yid la thugs kyi byin rlabs༞ ma dag gzung 'dzin༞ yid kyi bar chad༞ chos sku༞ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /ma dag mtshan 'dzin zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum sgrib pa dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku lnga ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /shu bhaṃ// ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa la shugs rings dad pa'i rgyang 'bod thugs rje'i chu skyes zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /lam zab dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs/ shrī saṅgu ru pā de na mā mi/ mdo rgyud chos kyi bka' drin legs thob pa'i/ /bshes gnyen rnams dang khyad par gsang sngags mchog /bla med dbang bzhi rgyud dang man ngag gnang / /lam zab thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bcos min snying nas dad pa'i skad bsangs kyis/ /bla ma rgyang nas 'bod do thugs rjes bzung / /rnam pa kun tu spyi gtsug rtag bzhugs nas/ /'bral med ye shes byin rlabs 'jug par shog /pha rol phyin dang rdo rje theg pa las/

/gdams ngag zab dgu sna tshogs mang gsungs kyang / /kun gyi snying po mthar thug bla ma'i lam/ /gegs sel bogs 'don mchog dang thun mong gi/ /dngos grub 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas dad pas skad kyi nga ros 'bod/ /mos pa'i bu la sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs/ /byams pa'i phyag gnyis spyi bor bzhag nas kyang / /rtse gcig g.yel med thugs kyis bzung du gsol/ /phyi rol sgro 'dogs gcod byed sprul pa'i sku/ /rang byung ye shes ngo sprod longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang ba lhan skyes ston mdzad chos kyi sku/ /mthar thug shin tu rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid gdan gsum lha yi tshogs/ /'khor 'das kun khyab bde stong dbyer med pa'i/ /don dam kun rdzob bden gnyis zung 'jug sku/ /gnas lugs brjod bral snang tshul mi bslu ba'i/ /rten 'brel ma dag snang ngor so skye'i tshul/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /rigs drug bzang ngan snang ba ci shar kyang / /dpal ldan bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral bar/ /lus srog longs spyod dus gsum bde dge rnams/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas bdag 'bul gyis/ /shin tu brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams/ /khyed kyis spyan sngar bshags shing slar yang sdom/ /rang gzhan dge rtsa kun la yi rangs bgyi/ /'gro ba'i don phyir chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bgyis pa/ /gcig tu bsdom nas mar gyur sems can kun/ /bla med sangs rgyas thob phyir yongs su bsngo/ /tshe 'dir tshul khrims dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bsgom zhing / /rim gnyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor legs bsgom te/ /phyag chen he ru ka dpal myur 'grub shog /ces pa 'di btsan la dbon po shes rab rgyal mtshan khams la 'gro khar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam gcig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/
